A '''laser pointer''' was a device used to project a harmless [[Laser/Legends|laser]] to use as a highlighter during presentations and briefings. The [[3D-4X administrative droid]] had a laser pointer built into its right index finger as a standard feature. Some [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] could be modified with laser pointers due to the ease with which the series could be upgraded.<ref name="EGTD" />
